meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: Claude 能从 claude-mem 的观察记录中按主题筛选出知识库(如“hooks 相关的一切”),把内容加载进一个 AI 会话,之后你可以就这些内容连续提问,它基于该知识库作答。
howto.when: 当你想从观察历史里建立某个主题的知识库、追问过往工作模式,或汇总某个主题的经验时触发。

say.text: 帮我建一个知识库,名字叫 hooks-expertise,主题是 hooks
say.note: 它会按条件筛选观察记录生成语料库

say.text: 把 hooks-expertise 这个知识库加载进会话
say.note: 会创建一个加载了该库内容的 AI 会话

say.text: 问 hooks-expertise:5 个生命周期钩子分别何时触发?
say.note: 它会基于该知识库内容回答

howto.what_en: Claude can filter claude-mem observations into topic-focused corpora, load one into an AI session, and then answer your follow-up questions from that corpus.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to build a focused knowledge base from your observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a topic.

say_en.text: Build a corpus named hooks-expertise about the hooks lifecycle

say_en.note: Loads its knowledge into an AI session

say_en.text: Ask hooks-expertise: when does each lifecycle hook fire?
